q: In the unfolding of a codimension-2 singularity (like a Takens-Bogdanov point with double-zero eigenvalue), the bifurcation diagram contains a curve of homoclinic orbits. This curve ends at:
opts: A point where the homoclinic orbit becomes a heteroclinic cycle or a degenerate homoclinic (e.g., the orbit returns tangentially — a homoclinic tangency)
exp: In the Bogdanov-Takens unfolding, the homoclinic curve (where a homoclinic orbit to the saddle exists) ends at the saddle-node curve. At the endpoint, the saddle and node merge (saddle-node on the invariant cycle), and the homoclinic orbit becomes a heteroclinic connection from the saddle-node to itself in the limit.
